findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nppes_enumeration_search · Private data: hcris_hospital_byCcn, carecompare_hospitals_byCcn, carecompare_snf_byCcn, carecompare_home-health_byCcn, carecompare_hospice_byCcn, carecompare_dialysis_byCcn, hpt_code_stats, providers_provider360, nppes_enumeration_search, openPayments_recipients_search · Public sink: prescribers_partDBrandShareShift_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nppes_enumeration_search · Private data: hcris_hospital_byCcn, carecompare_hospitals_byCcn, carecompare_snf_byCcn, carecompare_home-health_byCcn, carecompare_hospice_byCcn, carecompare_dialysis_byCcn, hpt_code_stats, providers_provider360, nppes_enumeration_search, openPayments_recipients_search · Public sink: prescribers_partDBrandShareShift_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
